analysis: The only change in this file is documentation: the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and a new paragraph at head lines 1577-1588. The paragraph says cluster stop waits, the 10-minute start wait and the desktop-app earnings windows compare times with timeIntervalSince(_:) instead of Date >= / <=. It adds that scripts/check-date-comparisons.py and scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py guard against the pattern in source and in the release binary. No code, configuration, protocol, authorization, attestation, encryption or key-handling behavior changes in the supplied diff. The surrounding unchanged text (logout/revoke, sandbox installer download, add-on hold, cache storage) was read as context only and is not part of the patch. It is consistent with TB-011, TB-012, TB-013, T-053 and T-061 as described, and this PR does not weaken any stated control. The new text asserts that the release build refuses a binary that imports the weak symbols. That is a build-integrity claim about scripts not supplied here, so those scripts were not verified. It is a documentation claim about a crash-loop availability fix, not a trust-boundary change. No finding qualifies, and no threat-model update is needed beyond confirming those scripts exist and behave as described if integration cares. The related source and scripts in other files were not in this batch, so nothing is claimed about their correctness.
